messages:
maria (eng-release): Quick status update — due to an unexpected capacity surge in us-west affecting serving pools, we're instituting a targeted freeze for non-critical changes on train-1 and train-3 for the next ~36h. This is NOT a full company freeze, but please DO NOT promote non-urgent PRs to canary for those trains until we lift this.

maria (eng-release): Freeze window: 2026-03-24 00:00 UTC -> 2026-03-25 12:00 UTC (approx). We may shorten if capacity stabilizes.

maria (eng-release): Affected: canary+canary-2 routes on train-1/train-3, scheduled rollouts for small infra changes. Not affected: emergency security hotfixes, critical customer rollouts (must tag with #urgent-release and get approvals).

cheng: Acked. Is this related to the memory leak we saw in the LRU cache earlier?

maria (eng-release): Short answer: partly. The memory pressure in us-west + a recent autoscaler tweak increased pod churn, which exposed a KV cache retention bug under load. We're stabilizing nodes and throttle-ing new canaries.

olivia: Do we have a recommended mitigation for folks mid-rollout? I have a canary stuck in progress.

maria (eng-release): If you're mid-canary: pause the rollout, mark PR with `needs-post-freeze` and revert to last stable config if automated rollback hasn't triggered. If you need help, ping #eng-oncall.

samir: tagging ops — @oncall-bot can you reroute traffic away from problematic hosts?

oncall-bot: @samir — reroute request received. Shifting 15% traffic off affected us-west hosts. ETA 90s.

deploy-bot: Deployment 17999-rt-canary started by olivia at 2026-03-23T23:58:12Z -> automatically paused due to freeze policy.

kate (pm): Folks, heads-up for product teams — any public-facing changes scheduled in next 48h should be postponed unless it's labeled #urgent-release. We'll post an update if we can lift the freeze early.

cheng: Any quick commands for rollback if needed?

maria (eng-release): Use the usual rollback script or the manual one-liner:
```
# rollback to previous stable revision
kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deployment/model-serving --to-revision=3
```
If rollback fails, ping me or @oncall.

olivia: Thanks. I'll tag my PR and pause canary.

samir: small note — caching patchset 5 passed perf locally but we should hold on integration tests until post-freeze.

maria (eng-release): Agreed. Also: doc update embargo — don't merge user-facing docs tied to these changes until train owners give the green light.

maria (eng-release): Troubleshooting runbook: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/serving-capacity-surge (checks to run: node mem, kube events, autoscaler logs, KV retention counters). Please add findings in this thread if you run checks.

cheng: Ran `kubectl describe pod` on svc-serving-2 — saw OOMs and frequent restarts, collecting logs now, will paste in a minute.

maria (eng-release): Thanks. If you see repeated OOMs, label the pod `diagnostic=frozen` and set restartPolicy=Never for deep inspection.

olivia: quick ack :thumbsup: — pausing canary and opening a follow-up ticket with the revert steps.

samir: ack :white_check_mark:

maria (eng-release): We'll do a status check at +6h and again before unfreezing. If you need an exception, DM me with justification and rollback plan.

deploy-bot: Auto-guard: PR promotions to canary blocked for trains [train-1, train-3] until 2026-03-25T12:00:00Z or manual override by @maria (eng-release).

oncall-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-034 — us-west serving surge. Assigned to cheng and infra-sre.

kate (pm): Thanks all — will coordinate comms with CS for any customer-impacting symptoms.

maria (eng-release): Closing loop: please keep comments short here. We'll post a firm lift time or extension in this thread. Appreciate quick responses and owners stepping up. :heart:
